import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Marovoay, Madagascar location
marovoay = ee.Geometry.Point([45.3656, -16.3667])  # Lon, Lat
aoi = marovoay.buffer(5000)  # 5km buffer

# 2. Load Sentinel-2 data with cloud masking
def mask_clouds_s2(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    # Mask clouds and cirrus
    cloudBitMask = 1 << 10
    cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

def add_ndwi(image):
    ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B11']).rename('NDWI')
    return image.addBands(ndwi)

# 3. Collect data for January 27, 2020
col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') \
    .filterBounds(aoi) \
    .filterDate('2020-01-25', '2020-01-29') \
    .map(mask_clouds_s2) \
    .map(add_ndwi)

size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo()
print(f"2020-01-27 Images: {size_2020}")

if size_2020 == 0:
    print("No images for 2020. Trying broader date range...")
    col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') \
        .filterBounds(aoi) \
        .filterDate('2020-01-20', '2020-02-05') \
        .map(mask_clouds_s2) \
        .map(add_ndwi)
    size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo()
    print(f"Retry 2020: {size_2020} images")

# 4. Collect data for January 18, 2017
col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') \
    .filterBounds(aoi) \
    .filterDate('2017-01-15', '2017-01-21') \
    .map(mask_clouds_s2) \
    .map(add_ndwi)

size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
print(f"2017-01-18 Images: {size_2017}")

if size_2017 == 0:
    print("No images for 2017. Trying broader date range...")
    col_2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') \
        .filterBounds(aoi) \
        .filterDate('2017-01-10', '2017-01-30') \
        .map(mask_clouds_s2) \
        .map(add_ndwi)
    size_2017 = col_2017.size().getInfo()
    print(f"Retry 2017: {size_2017} images")

# 5. Check if collections have data
if size_2020 == 0 or size_2017 == 0:
    print("C1")
    exit()

# 6. Extract water pixels (NDWI > 0.3) for each date
img_2020 = col_2020.first()
water_2020 = img_2020.select('NDWI').gt(0.3)
count_2020 = water_2020.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=aoi,
    scale=10,
    maxPixels=1e8
).get('NDWI').getInfo()

img_2017 = col_2017.first()
water_2017 = img_2017.select('NDWI').gt(0.3)
count_2017 = water_2017.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=aoi,
    scale=10,
    maxPixels=1e8
).get('NDWI').getInfo()

print(f"Water pixels 2020-01-27: {int(count_2020) if count_2020 else 0}")
print(f"Water pixels 2017-01-18: {int(count_2017) if count_2017 else 0}")

# 7. Validation
if count_2020 is None or count_2017 is None:
    print("C3")
elif count_2020 == 0 or count_2017 == 0:
    print("C2")
elif count_2020 > count_2017:
    print("A")
else:
    print("B")
